facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2015-0095 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 26 July 2015 following 1 recorded event in the archive, including INC-2015-007. The change request record covers 5 clauses across 5 controlled documents. The intent is to replace an existing requirement with one written to the current house style. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the critical safeguard set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are MOC-2019-0221, PRO-MEC-021, PTW-STD-002, STD-ISO-006 and STD-PTW-001.
